title: OpenING: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Judging Open-ended Interleaved Image-Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the evaluation scores and win rates assigned by a GPT-4o automated judge to its own outputs (e.g., GPT-4o+DALL-E-3) against human judgments, revealing a systematic bias where the model disproportionately favors and assigns perfect scores to its own generated content over human-annotated or competing models' content.
